title: Why Indian balconies have iron grills, and why fire officers want them to open
description:
Grills keep burglars out, but a fully closed grill can trap people in a fire. After a 2021 Bengaluru fire, the civic body said balcony grilles need its approval; Mumbai's fire chief asks for openable grills with a breakable lock.
Sources: The News Minute (23 Sep 2021), Free Press Journal (6 Apr 2022), Citizen Matters (Sep 2020), Asian Age (Oct 2018). Some visuals are AI visualisation. Educational content.
